body:
🤖 Four repositories now have audited results and verified HF evidence snapshots. The unchanged primary campaign is continuing serially; this is a partial report, not the ten-repository conclusion.

| Repository | Furthest stage / outcome | Model cost (actual USD) |
| --- | --- | ---: |
| SAMtools | Exhausted 20 bootstrap turns; PR discovery never reached | 0.872043 |
| Scanpy | Two exports; one verified tracked-test task, zero clean oracle commands; the other task's controls timed out | 0.559917 |
| MACS | Installed and saved a flagged bootstrap image; PR discovery failed on GitHub GraphQL HTTP 504 | 0.526755 |
| OpenMS | Pinned source checkout exceeded upstream's 60-second timeout before the first model request | 0 |

These four attempts account for $1.958715 in actual model charges and 8.367550 allocated CPU-hours. Active/subsequent runs are excluded from that partial total. MACS and OpenMS returned no native candidate list; those counts are unavailable, not evidence of zero suitable PRs. No API/checkout retry, environment repair, parser change or timeout increase was applied. LAMMPS is the next original handle in the fixed cohort.

Each result's original phase evidence, logs, exact configuration, source notices and derived assessment are retained with fresh anonymous HF hash readback. Whole-account usage snapshots and redundant wrapper archives are excluded and removed locally after verification. Owned Docker cleanup is verified for all four. [Full ten-row accounting report](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/c1f430d21e664362b9513c40f7f6341501408970/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/cohort-report.md) · [MACS archive receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/c1f430d21e664362b9513c40f7f6341501408970/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/archives/macs3-project__MACS-receipt.json) · [OpenMS archive receipt](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/c1f430d21e664362b9513c40f7f6341501408970/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/archives/OpenMS__OpenMS-receipt.json).

A separate [read-only pinned-source audit](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/c1f430d21e664362b9513c40f7f6341501408970/experiments/28-catalogued-fields/preflight/parser-filter-audit.json) confirms the default new-test-function filter and its language-specific regex, plus missing explicit CTest/standalone GoogleTest parsers. These are static limits, not the observed cause of the early MACS/OpenMS failures. Every submitted native payload/config still matches the original execution checkpoint.
